source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: MessageSend retains the outgoing listener before onSendStart provides a cancelable request. The listener stores early cancellation and applies it at start. SmtpServer guards cancellation and terminal notification, releases a drain wait and ignores later callbacks after cancellation. Components.Exception carries the send result into comm native rejection handling, allowing the UI and native alert path to recognize NS_ERROR_ABORT. These static contracts do not prove every error path settles, nor establish EWS or Gecko helper behavior.
title: SMTP cancellation keeps an early status until the outgoing request exists
